# Tropical Experts Costa Rica

> Private shuttles and airport transfers in Costa Rica, run by a family company based in La Fortuna (Arenal). Door-to-door private transfers from SJO and Liberia (LIR) airports and between destinations across the country, at a flat price per vehicle with taxes included. Licensed by the Costa Rica Tourism Board (I.C.T. license #3946-2025).

Founded in 2023 by Johnson Paniagua and Andrea Segura; a team of professional drivers covers the whole country. Spanish and English spoken. Every booking is a private vehicle for one group (no shared shuttles).

## Key facts

- Price per vehicle, not per person; taxes and tolls included. Vehicles: Hyundai Staria (1–5 passengers, 5 large bags); Toyota Hiace (6–9 passengers, 9 large bags); Maxus V90 (10–12 passengers, 12 large bags).
- Sample fares (1–5 passengers / 6–9 passengers / 10–12 passengers): SJO airport → La Fortuna $220/$275/$360 (approx. 3 h); Liberia airport (LIR) → La Fortuna $225/$280/$365 (approx. 2 h 45 min); La Fortuna → Monteverde $255/$300/$385 (approx. 3 h 15 min); La Fortuna → Manuel Antonio $360/$405/$490 (approx. 5 h); SJO airport → Manuel Antonio $220/$300/$360 (approx. 3 h); Liberia airport (LIR) → Tamarindo $135/$190/$275 (approx. 1 h 15 min).
- Included: driver waiting at arrivals with a name sign, flight tracking, WiFi, bottled water, child seats at no cost on request, pickups 24/7.
- Optional Tropical Experts VIP: +$80 per vehicle for 1–2 hours of sightseeing stops, a guaranteed bilingual driver and a welcome kit; extra hours $35 each, up to 4.
- Multi-day private driver (3 days or more): from $365 per day for the whole vehicle.
- Booking: online price calculator on the home page; several legs can go in one cart with one payment. Card payment (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) on Tilopay's secure page; SINPE Móvil or bank transfer arranged on WhatsApp. Online bookings need at least 12 hours' notice; for shorter notice, ask on WhatsApp.
- Cancellation: free up to 48 hours before pickup; within 48 hours no refund, except a flight cancellation documented by the airline.
- Ratings (November 2026): 5.0 on Google (116 reviews), 5.0 on Tripadvisor (37 reviews).
